info.title: MEKI API
info.description: MEKI core backend. Public endpoints (`/api/v1/public/*`) serve only published, non-demo content. Admin endpoints (`/api/v1/admin/*`) require the HttpOnly session cookie and, for mutations, the `X-CSRF-Token` header. Responses: `{ data }` or `{ data, meta }`; errors: `{ error: { statusCode, code, message, details? } }`.

temporaryPassword.description: Temporary password; user must change it at first login

paymentsEnabled.description: Rejected unless the server has an approved provider configured

labelsEn.description: Flat map of short labels, e.g. { "visionLabel": "Our vision" } (max 40 keys, 500 chars each)
